interfaceGapsNoted: CASE_SCHEMA_R7D.json still requires substitution.exerciseRef.day, while R7D-INTERFACE-8 section 2 allows {week, pattern} with no day; check-corpus.mjs accepts the pattern-only form, which H05 uses.

loadsByPattern takes one kilogram value per pattern in "the row's own convention", but the author cannot know which exercise (and so which convention) the coach puts in a pattern, nor separate two loaded exercises of one pattern; loads were stated for the athletes' known or only-possible loaded exercises.

There is no pattern-level way to log a strength session without reps in reserve, or a heavier setting that missed its target; explicit exercises need the coach-chosen exercise ids, which the author can only take from the athlete's known exercises (H03, H30). If the coach chose other ids, those logs do not match a row.

The bulk form cannot select part of a week's same-sport sessions, so reports of part of a week next to a break use day references; check-corpus-8 flags 15 such references (H04, H09, H22, H23, H26, H31, H32, H33) although each day is fixed, and they are kept with that reason in domainNotes.

No assertion type reads the returned record (separateBreaks stop values, reentryWeek, ownReturn, loadQuestions, missingInputs), so per-sport re-entry, own-return, start-time and load-confirmation outcomes are written as JUDGED expectations.
The start-time question (missingInputs interruption.startedAt) has no documented question kind for QUESTION_KIND_IS; H29 and H31 to H33 assert it through STATUS_IN and JUDGED.

Whether a race week holds only race touch, optional shakeout and race depends on whether the coach composed harder sessions earlier (and on graduation offers the author cannot foresee); those items carry their extra case and use bulk references.

The interface does not say how a weekly review placed before its week's last session is read (used for breaks stated while under way and for the last week's first-evening decision); check-corpus.mjs accepts it.
No rule says whether a client re-sends an event that came with an UNREPORTED_TRAINING question once the question is answered; H16 and H17 re-send it after the answer.
